paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 μeV
notes: Cavity haloscope search for axion-photon coupling between 21.86 and 22.00 ueV. Excluded g_agamma >= 0.93 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL. The KSVZ coupling at ~22 ueV (5.3 GHz) is approximately |g_agamma| ~ 2.1e-13 GeV^-1; 0.93x gives ~1.9e-13 GeV^-1. Exact numerical g_agamma values not tabulated in text; data points estimated from KSVZ relation and mass range endpoints. Local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 stated explicitly. | Vision: Y-axis is plotted as ratio g_aγγ/g_aγγ^KSVZ (0.75-2.0). Converted to absolute GeV^-1 assuming g_aγγ^KSVZ ≈ 7.0e-15 GeV^-1 at 22 μeV. Exclusion limit ~0.93×KSVZ. Sharp spikes near 21.905 and 21.91-21.92 μeV (TE313 mode mixing) and at band edges. Absolute scale is approximate due to ratio-based axis. | Calibration: Benchmark KSVZ consistent (ratio=1.20) | No calibration needed
